defects.rootCause: Operator sent CLI-style target preview in REST redeploy. Existing rejection proof accepted only a different legacy request envelope, preventing honest representation of the observed rejection.

defects.regression: 137 focused checks include both exact request variants, foreign hash/status/source/replay denial and pure builder17event/scope/no-target tests.
defects.historicalPrevention: Always derive future REST refresh requests with cfg.deploymentRequest after live lease and durable marker verification; preserve actual rejected request rather than fabricate the legacy hash.

rollback: Revert additive builder/hash variant only through reviewed feature source; preserve cancelled intent, rejection evidence, false flags and original hashes. No reactivation or provider retries.
